name: Mimikyu
prompt: Explicit reuse of the genuinely newly built-in drawn Totem atlas for normal Mimikyu. All eight native actions and all346 cropped frames in each normal/shiny variant are exactly identical across both forms. This is audited equivalent-form derivation, not independent target generation. Repack eight genuinely newly drawn poses, one wince and one grounded pose per cardinal heading, from mimikyutotem-two-pose60-v1.png. Pain uses exact native Idle entry then the newly drawn wince; HitGround transitions from that same wince to the new prone body held until recall. No rotated/warped standing pixels or synthetic fallback. Original generation prompt is saved with the raw source.

review.scope: Independent visual review, normal and shiny separately; exact PNG hashes checked
